title: epicrop
text: {epicrop} provides R package ‘EPIRICE’ model described (Savary et al. 2012), modified EPIRICE model described (Kim et al. 2015), ‘EPIWHEAT’ model described (Savary et al. 2015) generic SEIR model function, epicrop_sim(), modelling crop disease epidemics. model uses daily weather data estimate disease intensity. function, get_wth(), provided simplify downloading weather data via {nasapower} package (Sparks 2018) predict disease intensity five rice diseases using generic SEIR model (Zadoks 1971) function, epicrop_sim(). ‘EPIRICE’, default values derived literature suitable modelling unmanaged disease intensity five rice diseases, bacterial blight (bacterial_blight()); brown spot (brown_spot()); leaf blast (leaf_blast()); sheath blight (sheath_blight()) tungro (tungro()) two modified Kim et al. (2015), (modified_kim_leaf_blast() helper_modified_kim_sheath_blight()), provided. modified Kim versions provide leaf blast sheath blight models include additional weather parameters modified equations better reflect disease progress certain environmental conditions Korean Peninsula. ‘EPIWHEAT’ model includes two wheat diseases, leaf rust (leaf_rust()) septoria tritici blotch (s_tritici_blotch()), default values derived literature suitable modelling unmanaged disease intensity diseases. Using package functions designed straightforward modelling rice disease risks, flexible enough accommodate pathosystems using epicrop_sim() function. interested modelling pathosystems, please refer (2012) development parameters used rice diseases derived existing literature implemented individual disease model functions.
